title: HAVE YOU FOUND THE SAVIOR PRECIOUS?
stanzas: Have you found the Saviour precious? found His Love and pard'ning grace, Come, and by His word directed; His example learn to trace, He was buried low beneath the liquid wave
To the flowing streams of Jordan, Lo! The King of Zion came, There the ancient Baptist waited, to immerse the spotless Lamb: they descended to the saviour's watery grave.
Thus baptiz'd the great Redeemer. show'd the way His saints should thread, and when rising from the water, God approv'd and blest the deed, and the spirit rested on His sacred head.
